metadata.methods_description: Participants studied visually presented word lists, completed arithmetic distractor problems, and freely recalled the words. Each session had 26 lists, with no stimulation on the first 4. The remaining lists were split evenly between stimulation and no-stimulation conditions. On stimulation lists, classifier output for the 0-1366 ms after word onset was compared with the training median. If it was below the median, 500 ms of stimulation was delivered to a single electrode. The classifier was an L2 logistic regression on Morlet wavelet spectral power features (3-180 Hz), validated by leave-one-session-out cross-validation.
